params.prompt: Create a photorealistic modern living room. Cover the entire floor with the flooring material from Image 1 and install the baseboard or wall molding from Image 2 along every visible wall-floor edge. Preserve the exact material colors, wood grain and proportions from both references. Use a clean wide-angle interior composition with realistic daylight. Do not place loose sample boards, product packages, labels, logos or text inside the room.
params.instruction: Treat the references as material samples. Preserve the exact color, texture and profile of each material and apply them naturally to the architecture.
